name: Omi
source:
An old-timer of the Gohongatana Clan, he is Shigure's right-hand man and participates in planning, managing clan members, and leading military operations. 
Although he is wary of outsiders and it's not easy to win his trust, he can be described as a giant with a gentle heart and is easily moved to tears, which makes him a target of Shigure's teasing every time. He is a stable presence who provides invaluable moral support to Shigure and is deeply trusted by him in return.
He maintains discipline within the organization and can often be heard lecturing Shigure as one would an unruly kid.

"You'd be setting a bad example as a leader. I hate to say it, but it seems that you still haven't outgrown your childhood habit of relying on Yuuma. I'd spank you if you were my son."
